This is my prediction. It isn't good, but it is what I am seeing every single day in the real world. 

Many MAGA voters are disappointed, and the worst of these feel totally disenfranchised by the last two years. They aren't going to suddenly vote Democrat but at least some portion of them won't vote at all. Dem turnout is going to be huge no matter what. 

GOP Congress has failed to deliver any meaningful legislation in 2 years. The BBB was a spending bonanza and everything else was dogshit floating in an Indian river. 

We are going to spend the next 2 months hearing about "combatting election fraud" here on PDW. Everyone and their mother will proudly declare how we are battling election fraud. 

Then the GOP will lose both houses of Congress because they haven't done a damn thing...and rather than admit that as the reason we will then begin hearing about how the GOP only lost because of "fraud" and illegals voting and dead people voting. 

Don't get me wrong those things happen but they are NOT going to be the reason the GOP loses in November. 

Then we're going to spend the next 2 years doing absolutely nothing and a House controlled by Hakeem Jeffries is going to impeach Trump at every opportunity.
